description.fun: Eevee's DNA is unusually unstable, so it adapts to its surroundings by evolving into any of eight different Pokémon, more branches than any other species. Fittingly, its name comes from E-V, the first letters of 'evolution', and 21 November (11/21, read 'i-i-bu-i' in Japanese) is officially Eevee Day.
description.guide: A small, fox-like Pokémon whose unstable DNA lets it adapt to its surroundings by evolving. Eevee has eight possible evolutions, more than any other species, and its name comes from E-V, the start of 'evolution'.
description.tagline: One fluffy Pokémon, eight possible futures.

branches.text: Eevee's future depends on what it meets. Three stones worked from the start; since Generation 2 a close bond turns it into Espeon by day or Umbreon by night; since Generation 4 special rocks (now stones) give Leafeon and Glaceon; and since Generation 6 a Fairy-type move plus a close bond gives Sylveon.

description.fun: Its collar grows so fluffy and luxurious that foes caught in it lose the will to fight, and it only wants to play.

Vaporeon's cells are so like water molecules that it can melt into water and vanish, letting it swim up on prey unseen. Its split tail fin has been mistaken for a mermaid's, and it's thought to be where mermaid stories began; fittingly, designer Atsuko Nishida drew it with mermaids in mind. Its fins quiver when they sense rain on the way.
description.guide: One of Eevee's evolutions, a blue Water Pokémon with fins, gills and a mermaid-like tail. Eevee evolves into it with a Water Stone. It can blend into water to become invisible and lives near clean lakes and shores.
description.tagline: An Eevee that can melt into water

description.fun: Jolteon's fur is made of electrically charged needles: when it's angry or startled they stiffen into sharp quills it can fire at foes, before it finishes them off with a 10,000-volt thunderbolt. An organ in its lungs makes electricity, so it crackles when it breathes out, even in its sleep. It's sensitive and quick to get sad or angry, and it charges up each time its mood changes.
description.guide: One of Eevee's evolutions, a yellow Electric Pokémon with spiky fur that stiffens into sharp needles when it is charged. Eevee evolves into it with a Thunder Stone. It is very fast and may be inspired by the raijū, a lightning beast from Japanese myth.
description.tagline: An Eevee whose fur bristles into electric needles

description.fun: Flareon has a flame chamber inside its body, and when it's excited its temperature can reach about 900°C; it fluffs out its collar to let the heat escape. Air stored in its flame sac comes out as fire over 1,600°C, and it roasts its berries and prey before eating them. In Scarlet and Violet it's the only Eeveelution that can't swim, so it stands on a platform for battles on water.
description.guide: One of Eevee's evolutions, an orange Fire Pokémon with a fluffy yellow mane and tail. Eevee evolves into it with a Fire Stone. It stores heat in a flame chamber inside its body and breathes fire.
description.tagline: A fiery Eevee that fluffs its collar to cool off

description.fun: Espeon's fine, velvety fur senses the tiniest shifts in the air, letting it predict the weather and an opponent's next move; the tip of its forked tail quivers as it does. It's said to have developed these powers to protect a Trainer it trusts. It charges up by basking in sunlight, so it isn't good at battling at night. Its forked tail recalls the nekomata, a magical cat of Japanese folklore.
description.guide: One of Eevee's evolutions, a lilac, cat-like Psychic Pokémon introduced in Generation 2, with a red gem on its forehead and a forked tail. Eevee evolves into it with high friendship during the day. It draws power from sunlight and senses what is coming through its fur.
description.tagline: A sun-loving psychic cat that reads the air

description.fun: Moonlight changed Eevee's genes to make Umbreon, and on the night of a full moon its yellow rings glow with a mysterious power. It hides in the dark in its black fur, waiting for prey or for a foe to make a move, and when angered it sprays poisonous sweat at its target's eyes. In the 2020 Pokémon of the Year poll, fans voted it the most popular Eeveelution.
description.guide: One of Eevee's evolutions, a black Dark Pokémon with glowing yellow rings, introduced in Generation 2. Eevee evolves into it with high friendship at night, as exposure to moonlight changed its genes. It is nocturnal and sees clearly in total darkness.
description.tagline: A moonlit Eevee with glowing rings

description.fun: Leafeon's cells are more like a plant's than an animal's, so instead of eating it sunbathes, using photosynthesis, and cleans the air around it as it dozes. It prefers not to fight, but to protect its friends it sharpens its leafy tail into a blade said to be sharper than a sword. Its scent changes from fresh grass when it's young to fallen leaves as it ages, and in Galar it's made into a popular perfume.
description.guide: One of Eevee's evolutions, a tan and green Grass Pokémon introduced in Generation 4, with leaf-shaped ears and tail. Eevee evolves into it with a Leaf Stone, or by levelling up near a Moss Rock. It uses photosynthesis instead of eating and purifies the air.
description.tagline: A leafy Eevee that lives on sunshine

description.fun: Glaceon can drop its body temperature to −60°C, freezing its fur into needle-sharp icicles it can fire at foes. With a single cry it turns the moisture in the air into glittering diamond dust, a snowfall so lovely that anyone captivated by it freezes without noticing. Its knack for making powdery snow makes it popular at ski resorts.
description.guide: One of Eevee's evolutions, a light-blue Ice Pokémon introduced in Generation 4, with a crest like a winter hat. Eevee evolves into it with an Ice Stone, or by levelling up near an Ice Rock. It can freeze its fur into icicles and make diamond dust.
description.tagline: An icy Eevee that makes it snow diamonds

description.fun: Sylveon's ribbon-like feelers give off a soothing aura that melts away hostility and can stop a fight instantly, and it wraps them around its Trainer's arm as they walk to read their feelings. It isn't only sweet, though: it will charge bravely at a dragon Pokémon far bigger than itself, a feat told as a fairy tale in Galar. It loves dancing in flower meadows.
description.guide: One of Eevee's evolutions, a cream and pink Fairy Pokémon introduced in Generation 6, with ribbon-like feelers. Eevee evolves into it when it has a close bond and knows a Fairy-type move. It is the only Eeveelution that debuted on its own, with no other new Eeveelution in its generation.
description.tagline: A ribbon-trailing fairy that can calm any fight

note.text: Until Generation 8 the only way was to level up near a Moss Rock.

note.text: Until Generation 8 the only way was to level up near an Ice Rock.
